entrypoint: new MultiInputVerificationCases(baselineGraph, candidateGraph); addCase(baselineBundle, candidateBundle); verify(baselineRegistry, baselineGraph, candidateRegistry, candidateGraph, absTol, relTol)

authority.numerical_execution: both compiled graphs run through the Burn reference interpreter
authority.receipt: WASM observation of completed comparison cases; mismatch returns equivalent:false
authority.host_durable_execution_receipt: separate Node ledger contract, not produced by this verifier

case_contract.input_port_declarations: baseline and candidate have identical ordered slot, role, shape, layout, fingerprint requirement and minimum revision
case_contract.input_values: both bundles for each case have the same slot, rank-four shape and exact f32 bits
case_contract.input_sha256: SHA-256 of ordered slot:u8 + four dimensions:u64 little endian + f32 bit patterns little endian for every bound slot
case_contract.snapshot: addCase clones bundles after complete input preflight; later caller changes to the original bundles do not alter accepted cases
case_contract.pre_execution: all cases repeat graph, registry and value preflight before the first Burn run

state_contract.baseline_and_candidate_registries: passed independently; identical layer IDs are allowed
state_contract.checkpoint_digest: SHA-256 of the exact stateful multi-input ProgramBundle exported for each graph immediately before execution
state_contract.stability: both checkpoint byte digests are rechecked before and after each baseline and candidate run
state_contract.on_change: error, no verification receipt; no rollback of a state mutation is claimed
state_contract.trust: checkpoint bytes and digests have no origin signature

comparison.per_element_pass: abs(a-b) <= absTol + relTol * max(abs(a), abs(b), f64::EPSILON)
comparison.shape_mismatch: negative receipt with null per-case errors and no compared elements for that case
comparison.aggregate_errors: maxima over cases whose output shapes match; null if none match
comparison.equivalent: all cases completed, shapes matched and every output element met tolerance

receipt_digest: SHA-256 over the exact compact UTF-8 JSON bytes with fixed Rust field order, without receipt_digest; a content correlation value rather than a signature or unique execution ID
limits: Test vectors are selected by the caller; passing them establishes no general equivalence beyond the tested cases.
Input source, revision and fingerprint metadata are checked against each local plan but are not authenticated or part of input_sha256.
Calling verify again executes both programs again; identical receipt digests may describe separate executions over identical bytes.
Different output shape is a failed numerical comparison, while invalid preflight, mutable-state drift and execution fault yield no receipt.
A verifier receipt neither authorizes graph mutation nor commits a candidate as a promoted model.
